pages.name: Cocoa and chocolate products (cocoa powder, dark, milk, chips)
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified standard for Cocoa and chocolate products (cocoa powder, dark, milk, chips) (Chocolate, Cocoa and Confectionery), stated as sold. Each analyte carries the strictest applicable government maximum level in the product's native basis, with a disclosed read-across or a mandatory control where no government regulates the exact product.
